leagues.name: VFF Champions League (formerly VFF National Super League)
leagues.note: 6 of the league's 8 clubs named for the 2025 season (the VFF Champions League, Vanuatu's national top flight, drawing the top teams from 7 provincial associations since Port Vila's association stopped taking part in 2016). ABM Galaxy FC confirmed 2025 champions; Tupuji Imere FC confirmed 6th place. 2 of the 8 slots could not be individually confirmed in this session. Supersedes the prior entry, which found no current-season roster at all.
